verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own docs say agents can be deployed and run on a schedule or on demand. Its product pages also describe agents running continuously to monitor products and alert on breakage, which is a recurring workflow. Missing for 10: detailed docs on schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax, management via API/SDK, run history), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
Run agents that click through your product continuously and alert you the moment something breaks.
